actual_scope: Kappa-blocker KB3h (explicit open request; set level, no words): kill or classify the surviving non-tight (12,6) A-vanish classes (5,1),(4,2),(3,3) of the 18-point cover question for F2^7 (PR 943 model P + P = F2^7; PR 2911 reduction (A, D) in E = F2^6 with A + D = E and (A+A) u (D+D) = E) - the recorded remainder of PR 2961 (its open question 1), which decides the f(7) L=22 route. Delivered outcome=partial: class (5,1) is PROVEN impossible and (4,2)/(3,3) are reduced to exact walkable forms but not decided. (1) (12,6) A-vanish (5,1): PROVEN impossible. Exact reduction (the singleton D1 = {d1} is absorbed by the two half-translations U = A0+d1, V = A1+d1, W = D0+d1; each preserves all four PR 2933 L3 lines; residual symmetries give WLOG 0 in U, 0 in V) to triples (U, V 6-sets, W 5-set) of F2^5 with (a) V u (U+W) = F2^5, (b) U u (V+W) = F2^5, (c) (U+V) u W = F2^5, (d) (U+U) u (V+V) u (W+W) u {0} = F2^5. Complete walk: all 169,911 normalized U (0 in U) and all 3,049,492,320 normalized pairs (U, V) with 0 in V and |U+V| >= 27 (line (c) forces M = F2^5 \ (U+V) into W, |M| <= 5; pair counts by |U+V| = 27/28/29/30: 1,439,907,840 / 1,572,086,880 / 29,998,080 / 7,499,520). Exact obstruction: ZERO W candidates satisfy (a)+(b)+(c) for ANY pair (w_candidates=0 over the whole walk), so lines (a) and (b) are jointly unsatisfiable once W must contain M and have size 5; covering_configs=0. The walk engines are validated against complete brute force (pair enumeration and W enumeration equal brute force on sampled slices; the optimized engine equals the independent reference engine on full U slices; m=3/m=4 analogue censuses agree with direct A,D coverage tests on 22 classes including cover-bearing positive controls and empty floor-surviving controls, with semantic failure controls). (2) (12,6) A-vanish (4,2): classified, not decided. D1 = {d1, d1+delta} normalizes to {0, 1} (delta = 1 under GL(5,2), d1 absorbed): triples (U, V 6-sets, W 4-set) with (a') (U+W) u (V+{0,1}) = F2^5, (b') (U+{0,1}) u (V+W) = F2^5, (c') (U+V) u (W+{0,1}) = F2^5, (d') (U+U) u (V+V) u (W+W) u {0,1} = F2^5; exact necessary budgets |U+W| >= 20, |V+W| >= 20 (excess <= 4 over 24 pairs each), |U+V| >= 24. The complete walk is strictly larger than (5,1)'s (line (c') only forces M into W u (W+1)) and was not run in budget. (3) (12,6) A-vanish (3,3): classified, not decided. No singleton absorption exists; the four L3 lines apply directly to (A0, A1 6-sets, D0, D1 3-sets) with 0 in A0, 0 in A1 (or 0 in D0, 0 in D1) WLOG; every line budget is slack (line (IV) 36+9 >= 32, line (I)/(II) 36 >= 32) and no forced Sidon structure exists. No 18-point cover was constructed anywhere and no kappa, supplier or selected-frontier claim is made. The word-level gap recorded at this package's base commit is 20 <= f(7) <= 24; the concurrent word-level correction PR 2973 (Nicholas Stone, merged; corroborated by PR 3005, Nick Petalas) records 22 <= f(7) <= 24 and explicitly scopes the set-level chain PR 2773-2961 (and hence this package) as unaffected; under 22 <= f(7) <= 24 this package's question is the deciding necessary condition for f(7) = 22 (at L = 22 every universal word needs at least 18 distinct prefixes and their set must cover).

bottleneck_link: The set-level restricted addition basis value r((C2)^7) decides how small a universal word's prefix set can be inside the unchanged PR943 query model: 17-point covers are excluded (PR 2542/2773/2870) and the 18-point question is narrowed to four splits (PR 2911) with the vanishing classes pressed (PR 2933) and the tight classes decided (PR 2961). This package removes the smallest surviving non-tight class (12,6) A-vanish (5,1) outright and reduces (4,2)/(3,3) to exact walkable forms, feeding the word-level L=22 route its per-split feasibility. It changes no supplier, tariff or kappa and instantiates no physical interface.

The applicable diagnostic is exact reproduction against the pinned predecessor numbers plus complete exact-integer enumerations with brute-force-validated search engines.
